{{Quote|The secret to our mouthwatering nerfsteak is the seasoning: a unique blend of Serrian salt, tertium, punctil and black hole pepper that's been handed down in my family for generations.|From the menu at Dex's Diner|<ref name="Dex's" />}}
The [[Besalisk/Legends|Besalisk]] chef [[Dexter Jettster/Legends|Dexter Jettster]] used special '''nerfsteak seasoning''' on [[Nerf steak/Legends|nerfsteaks]], a dish that was served in his [[Restaurant/Legends|restaurant]], [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]], which was located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. The seasoning&mdash;which contained a blend of [[black hole pepper]], [[punctil]], [[Serrian salt]], and [[tertium]]&mdash;was a recipe that had been in his [[Dexter Jettster's family|family]] for many [[Standard year/Legends|years]], being passed down from generation to generation. Jettster considered the seasoning as the secret to his [[Nerf/Legends|nerfsteaks]]. The seasoning was used in his diner<ref name="Dex's" /> at some point no earlier than [[28 BBY/Legends|28 BBY]].<ref name="DexDates">{{Hyperspace|url=fans/hyperspace/source/dexdiner/index.html|text=Dining at Dex's|int=Dining at Dex's}} is set at some point no earlier than [[28 BBY/Legends|28 BBY]] per the {{DiningAtDexDate}}.</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Dexter Jettster's nerfsteak seasoning was mentioned in "[[Dining at Dex's]]," a [[2009]] [[StarWars.com]] [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] article written by [[Gregory Walker]] as an [[in-universe]] menu for Dex's Diner.<ref name="Dex's" />
